direct_official_checks: ground truth points are independently surveyed
points are captured on flat unambiguous surfaces
each ground truth point has plus/minus 3cm RMSE accuracy
ground truth attributes include date surface type survey method transformation and geoid model
ground truth may be reused if less than five years old inland
coastal reuse limit is three years
timestamped LIDAR must be below plus/minus 15cm RMSE to pass QC
standard deviation and random error must be below 10cm to pass QC
quality_effect: Separates independent QA-point accuracy from final parcel elevation uncertainty and enforces reuse-age limits.
